propositions: Add a count-pinned allowlist guard script that scans the repository for deprecated 'Success Criteria' vocabulary and enforces exact match counts across specified paths and exclusions.

Migrate residual live prose in src/rebar/llm/completion.py, tests/interfaces/store/test_completion_verifier.py, and docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl from 'Success Criteria' to 'Acceptance Criteria' terminology.
Wire the vocabulary guard into the root Makefile lint target so both local and CI runs enforce the same policy and fail on unallowlisted matches or count drift.

Preserve frozen migration evidence, captured Jira payloads, behavioral test probes, and four permanent semantic carve-outs (T2 experiment language, definition-of-done concept, registry migration tests, and historical citations) as non-vacuous allowlist entries.

Enforce scoped bare-token matching for 'SC' or 'SCs' only under src/rebar/llm/reviewers/, src/rebar/_guides/, .rebar/criteria_routing.json, src/rebar/llm/plan_review/criteria_routing.json, and generated docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md.
Validate that O-RAN-SC references in docs/adr files and .github/workflows remain byte-identical and that no live deprecated vocabulary exists outside the allowlist and documented exclusions.
